name: Popup Maker
couldBuild: A modal, a set of triggers (time, scroll, exit intent, click) and display conditions per post type. All of it is well-documented browser work.
stillMissing: Genuinely little. Cookie handling so a dismissed popup stays dismissed, and accessibility — focus trapping and escape handling — are the parts people forget rather than the parts that are hard. This is one of the most cloneable products in the index.
requirements: Modal with trigger rules: time, scroll depth, exit intent, click
Display conditions by post type, taxonomy and URL
Cookie rules so a dismissal persists

alternatives.name: Popup Maker (free)
alternatives.desc: The full popup engine is free; the paid extensions add targeting and integrations.

notes: BuiltWith files this under "Popup Maker for Wordpress" — the tech named plain "Popup Maker" is a different, tiny product.
